title: Correct multi-workflow release evidence validation
outOfScope: Creating, moving, deleting, or reusing a release tag.
Publishing a GitHub Release or altering release assets from this corrective Work Item.
Weakening CI, source binding, or release evidence requirements.

sources.reason: The v0.5.45 release failed at Generate source-bound release evidence before tag or asset creation.
Builds evidence from both smoke.yml and compatibility.yml run/job sets.
Incorrectly requires each workflow run required-job set to equal the top-level cross-workflow union.
Existing coverage only proves one workflow run and misses the multi-workflow union case.

rawUserRequest: Continue the approved corrective workflow after v0.5.45 release evidence generation failed. Repair the multi-workflow CI evidence validator with executable regression coverage; do not weaken gates or claim publication until provider evidence exists.

riskAssessment.reason: A malformed multi-workflow evidence model can either block valid releases or, if weakened incorrectly, conceal missing job evidence.

executionDecision.reason: The focused corrective implementation follows the recorded human decision after the exact release log established the fail-closed evidence-shape defect.

preReviewWarnings: Preserve fail-closed validation for missing jobs, non-success outcomes, head mismatch, and per-workflow job completeness.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A successful evidence document containing both smoke and compatibility workflow runs validates when the top-level required-job set is exactly their union.
A top-level set that omits or adds any job relative to the union of workflow-run sets remains rejected.
Existing failure boundaries for missing job evidence, failed job results, head binding, and invalid success conclusions remain enforced.
The release workflow evidence construction is verified against the corrected multi-workflow contract without creating a tag, provider Release, or asset.
The release failure and its corrective trace are recorded in the approved remediation plan.
guidelines: Keep CI evidence validation deterministic and fail closed.
Use real JSON fixtures and the production checker; do not mock the validator.
Do not weaken any source, job-status, or evidence-integrity boundary.
Record the precise corrective relationship before resuming publication.

intent.problem: Release run 30604361511 collected successful smoke and compatibility workflow evidence, but the validator rejected the valid cross-workflow job union because it required every individual workflow run to equal that union.
constraints: Retain independent per-workflow required-job and result verification.
Use focused checks under the pre-agreed temporary efficiency terms; Hosted CI remains mandatory before merge.
Do not publish or reserve v0.5.45 from this Work Item.
intent.rationale: Correct union semantics express the actual evidence topology without falsely requiring unrelated workflow runs to contain each other's jobs.

declaredIntent.summary: Repair the release-evidence validator so independently successful smoke and compatibility runs can prove a single source-bound release candidate without weakening evidence integrity.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Successful smoke and compatibility evidence has distinct required-job sets whose union is the top-level set.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The production validator accepts the evidence while retaining per-workflow job-success checks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused shell regression fixture with two workflow runs.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The top-level required-job set differs from the union of the workflow-run sets.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The production validator rejects the evidence with the required-job set diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused shell regression mutation of the multi-workflow fixture.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: One workflow run omits evidence or records a non-success required job.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Existing focused negative evidence regression cases.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff as one unit; do not retry publication from a partially corrected evidence model.
